core_principles.text: Aligning the index finger with the spine during shoulder-width push-ups can be used to target and increase the activation of the triceps brachii muscle.

specific_findings.text: A study of 50 subjects performing shoulder-width push-ups showed a significantly greater peak EMG activation in the triceps brachii muscle when using an index finger alignment with the spine compared to a pinky finger alignment.
Male subjects experienced significantly greater EMG activation in the triceps brachii, pectoralis major, and anterior deltoid muscles during push-ups compared to female subjects.
